get.description: Replaces getCanvasSession. Read-only persisted link; never issues a ticket, creates or wakes compute (U-1024-7 ②). The Agent is derived from the State Session; no context headers. Cross-tenant 404; data=null when no canvas is linked.

post.summary: Issue a one-time Canvas relay ticket
post.description: Replaces createCanvasSession. Reuses the existing RS256 realtime keyring and Redis single-use redemption; purpose canvas_session_agent without instance_id; 60 s. Never creates or wakes compute: offline Agents expose only persisted state. Redemption fences on the current Session state and Agent authorization revision. Admission is the first WebSocket frame on relay_url, or open_url?ticket= for an iframe, which exchanges the ticket for a single-use HttpOnly cookie and redirects without credentials (U-1024-7 ③). After Agent deletion only viewer tickets are issued (U-1024-7 ④). The same Idempotency-Key never replays the secret (409 secret_already_issued).

ServerAPIKey.description: 与 Cloud Server API 相同的 BeeOS Server API key（bsk_，Authorization: Bearer），由它确定 org/app；不接受在请求体里选择 tenant。方案名与 sdks/cloud-sdks/spec/server.openapi.json 的 ServerAPIKey 一致。

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 1..256字符；以organization_id+app_id+规范化语义操作+资源作用域去重；key/developer轮换不改变scope，先做当前身份授权。至少保留24h或操作终态后24h取晚者；secret/ticket例外见04。

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: 强ETag，例如"7"；对应被修改资源的resource_version；缺失428，旧值412；首次执行检查，同键重放先于检查。

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: 前页next_cursor；失效410 cursor_expired；不能跨租户/筛选复用。

CanvasId.description: Canvas service authoritative lowercase UUID (canvas/snapshot); no new ID.

CanvasTicket.description: One-time relay ticket; never log or replay it. Send it as the first WebSocket frame {"type":"authenticate","profile":"beeos-canvas-v1","ticket":...} on relay_url (subprotocol beeos-canvas-v1), or navigate an iframe to open_url?ticket=... which exchanges it for a single-use HttpOnly cookie and redirects without credentials.

origin.description: 浏览器客户端须提供精确 Origin；App 后端鉴权后转交票据。

AccessTicket.description: 短时连接票据；重复签发请求不重放 secret。

ticket.description: 一次性首帧凭据；不得记录、放 URL 或重放。

connect_url.description: 精确 WSS 端点；desktop 为信令端点，PTY 为数据端点。

transport.description: PTY=websocket；desktop=webrtc，WSS relay 降级由信令协商。

protocol_version.description: Business payload version1; admission/profile selected explicitly by profile, not by this legacy payload field.

pty_id.description: Reserved service terminalId; no PTY until terminal.open. Reconnect binds an existing terminalId.

reconnect_window_seconds.description: 仅PTY；从断线起服务端保留会话的窗口。数值须实测，不固定N分钟。

state.description: Read projection of Agent owner Binding state; no duplicate enum here.

AgentBindingObservation.description: Public projection only. prepared_config_revision comes from preparation.prepared_config.revision; credential_activation_revision from preparation.credential_activation.config.revision, which may remain older for unchanged valid materials. Server verifies exact publication/target/Host/fence before reporting ready; private evidence is never returned.

credential_status.description: Desired configuration slot membership, observable before compute exists. This is distinct from the actual prepared Binding slot status and credential activation revision; configured does not assert current source authorization or injection success.

affected_scopes.description: Complete actual enforcement observations, including scopes widened to Binding, Sandbox or Session. The legal tool, MCP and credential selectors may all be present; results must not be truncated to an input category's limit.

AuthorizationRevoke.description: Explicit security revocation of this Agent derived authority, not ordinary next-turn configuration and not upstream OAuth account deletion.

ResponseInputItem.description: Read-only committed input identity. id is the canonical State source ID, never a client supplied index or a synthesized gateway ID. Use it as NativeMemorySource.item_id.

continuation_available.description: False after Agent deletion or source-invalid native continuity; does not deny independently authorized history.

authorization_revision_at_admission.description: State authorization revision in Agent ExecutionConfigurationSelection / Connector ResolvedExecutionConfig; not the separate public revocation workflow token.

memory_read_watermark.description: Real State read watermark if memory read occurred; null only no read/unknown, never permanent P1 absence. Current authorization/erase still applies.

state.description: Read-time projection; a pending interaction whose expires_at has passed is reported as expired, and a reply to it returns 410 resource_expired instead of 409.

expires_at.description: Absolute expiry of this interaction. Honcho keeps the producer's pending row; readers and replies apply this instant.

sandbox_id.description: This Response's actual logical Sandbox, null before placement. Fixed once its execution placement is selected; not a lookup of the Agent's later Binding. Ephemeral recreation changes this ID while agent_id/session_id remain stable. Allocation identities stay internal.

status.description: waiting_input is produced while pending_interactions is non-empty; cancelling is the in-flight stop projection and cancelled its terminal fact. A timeout is a failure rather than a distinct status — failed with error.code=deadline_exceeded (there is no timed_out or unknown status).

phase.description: accepted then preparing_compute; loading_session while central history loads; executing during the turn; waiting_input while a typed interaction is pending; finished only for a terminal Response.
Same phase projection as NativeResponse.phase; only these values are produced.

result_path.description: Canonical path under /workspace; semantic boundary rejects dotdot/symlinks/reserved paths.

items.description: Canonical path under /workspace; semantic boundary rejects dotdot/symlinks/reserved paths.

result.description: Null while requested result is pending or capture unknown; not_requested is reserved for no result_path. Final collection sets ready/failed.

CredentialInputCapabilities.description: Service credential input modes from the existing Agent owner. Keys are discovered only through the anonymous UHP implementation.beeos_credential_input extension at discovery_path. This grants no per-App authoring or activation authority.

NativeCapabilities.description: Protocol feature support and engine session behavior from existing discovery/Driver receipts. Not deleted getSandboxCapabilities or Offering. Never marks proposal supported without implementation verification.

value.description: User-authored arbitrary JSON result, not control metadata; max 1MiB canonical encoded result, no stdout parsing.

TemplateHarnessArtifact.description: Read-only member of the frozen RuntimeArtifactSetManifest; same version, digests and typed recipe reference.

NativeMemorySource.description: Explicit reuses State MemorySourceInput's explicit branch. State atomically creates Assertion/Observation/Record and returns exact Receipt.source_refs. Response selectors resolve to State MessageSource from current authorized Message facts. No caller StateContext, trust, assertion ID, history generation or source revision. For a response source, item_id is an actual id returned by GET /v2/responses/{response_id}/input-items data[].id. Creation input has no identity field; output items are not eligible unless the source owner separately publishes a canonical identity.

OwnerOpaqueId.description: 平台自有资源 ID（Sandbox/Operation/WorkLease/Allocation/Binding 等）。不透明、区分大小写，客户端不得解析或拼接；首字符为字母或数字，其余为 [A-Za-z0-9_.-]，1–128 字符，不允许 ':' 与 '/'。UUID（可以数字开头）是合法值。字符集和长度与 backend/pkg/uhp/ids.go nativeID 相同，因此任一 OpaqueId 都能无损映射为 HarnessId 后缀。

OwnerResourceVersion.description: 资源控制面版本，单调递增的 JSON 整数，从 1 开始，在 JS 安全整数范围内；HTTP If-Match 用其带引号的十进制形式。F07：由 sandbox/04 拥有；agent-runtime 当前使用字符串形式，需要对齐。

OwnerError.description: Cloud Server API 错误对象，不嵌套，响应体就是它本身。code、message、request_id 必填（cloud-sdks ErrorResponse 与 T03 一致）。details、retry_after 来自 T03，可选。T03 声明了 additionalProperties:false，这里照搬。

code.description: 稳定机器码，Sandbox 使用的取值见 $defs/SandboxErrorCode。

message.description: 人类可读的说明，不得解析。

request_id.description: 与 X-Request-ID 响应头相同。

examples.message: The sandbox is resuming; retry later.

RequestId.description: 外来 ID：请求关联 ID，对应 X-Request-ID 响应头与 Cloud Error.request_id。生产方和校验规则见 backend/pkg/infrastructure/middleware/request_id.go：ValidRequestID 接受 1–128 个 [A-Za-z0-9._:-] 字符；客户端给的值不合法时，依次退回 OTel trace ID（32 位 hex）和随机 hex。不透明，客户端不得解析。字符集比 OpaqueId 宽（允许 ':'，首字符不限），所以不能 $ref OpaqueId。

ErrorDetails.description: Cloud T03 的 details（任意对象）。以下键是 Sandbox 的扩展提案，其他键允许出现。可重试信号不在 details 里，而在响应头 Should-Retry（true/false，未分类时省略，对齐 E2B）与 retry_after/Retry-After；公开面没有 Operation，不返回 operation_id（L12x）。

reason.description: 开放诊断字符串；公开请求与已接受轮失败的本轮 reason 唯一登记在根 x-reason-catalog（C5 授权 API 统一）。SDK 可读 reason，但未知值不能崩溃。Connector/State 既有内部 reason 仍见 15 §3.2，未转为公开端点。active_bindings、rootfs_ephemeral、resource_in_use、volume_busy、template_tag_exists、template_build_revoked、template_tag_not_found、template_build_mismatch、secret_like_env、prewarm_incompatible、snapshot_with_volumes_unsupported 仅可作内部历史原因，不再是公开操作分支；name_reserved 已撤销。

fields.description: 扩展提案：字段级错误，替代旧的 ErrorDetail[]。

related_resource.description: 扩展提案：code 为 secret_already_issued 时必有；只有可撤销的元数据，不含 secret。

RetryAfterSeconds.description: Cloud T03 的 retry_after：建议重试延迟，单位秒，整数 0–3600（backend/openapi/beeos-cloud/schemas/error.schema.json）。HTTP 头 Retry-After 用 RFC 9110 delay-seconds，取值与它相同。Sandbox 实际只发 1–60。

OwnerErrorResponse.description: Cloud Server API 的错误响应体，就是 Error 本身。

manifest_id.$comment: 与原 1–128 长度规则相同，规则归 ids.schema.json；不加 pattern，避免收紧既有值。

ExternalOpaqueRef.description: 外来不透明引用：生产方自由取值，代码只要求非空并按字节精确比较。可能含 ':' 与 '/'，因此不加 pattern。已知值包括：handlerIdentity 'agentbay-provider'、'beeos-browser-provider'、'beeos-codebuddy:<32hex>'；journalStoreId '<kind>/<instanceId>'（runtimeauthority/authority.go）、'browser:<instanceId>'（runtimes/browser-runtime/apps/runtime/src/enrollment.ts）、'beeos-codebuddy:<64hex>'；ACP sessionId（harness/beeos-codebuddy/src/app/session-pool.ts）。上限 128 是目标契约/待定：代码没有长度上限，已知生产值不超过 80。

OwnerOpaqueId2.description: 平台自有资源 ID（Sandbox/Operation/WorkLease/Allocation/Binding 等）。不透明、区分大小写，客户端不得解析或拼接；首字符为字母或数字，其余为 [A-Za-z0-9_.-]，1–128 字符，不允许 ':' 与 '/'。UUID（可以数字开头）是合法值。字符集和长度与 backend/pkg/uhp/ids.go nativeID 相同，因此任一 OpaqueId 都能无损映射为 HarnessId 后缀。

AgentId.description: 外来 ID：BeeOS Agent ID。生产方为 backend/services/agent/pkg/application/agent_service.go（uuid.New().String()/uuid.NewString()，36 位小写 UUID）。接受规则以 backend/pkg/uhp/ids.go 的 nativeID 为准（^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$），与 OpaqueId 字符集相同。不收紧为 UUID 形态，因为 uhp.HarnessID/AgentID 接受所有 nativeID。

RuntimeHarnessArtifact.description: One immutable first-phase Harness member. version/digests/recipe are fixed by the set, not selected from latest during Claim; no count field or arbitrary engine plug-in promise.

slots.description: Complete per-slot observations for this binding. Each slot appears once. A binding with no credential slots has an empty array; no secret, reference or ciphertext is returned.

BeeosTarget.description: Persistent desired placement. POST omission defaults to beeos/base/1800/terminate recipe; PUT omission preserves. Runtime Binding TargetSelector observes actual placement, never recipe.

template.description: U-1024-23：临时沙箱基础镜像的两个固定规格，2C4G 的 beeos/base 为默认，4C8G 的 beeos/base-4c8g 按需冷启动；规格写在模板里，创建后不可改。

Id.description: 本专题平台自有 ID 与回执引用。规则唯一 owner：API conventions（docs/architecture/sandbox/ids.schema.json OpaqueId：1..128，^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$，不含 ':' 与 '/'，UUID 合法）。agent-state persona/native schema 引用本 Id。

CredentialBindings.description: Write-only full replacement on update; omitted preserves, [] removes. Slot names must be unique and declared by immutable Driver artifact; semantic checks required.

ref.description: Authenticated org/API-client configured resolver interprets this opaque handle; never a caller-supplied fetch URL.

jwe.description: Compact JWE RSA-OAEP-256/A256GCM. Shape only: real cryptographic verification and protected-header/payload checks required.

AuthorizationRevision.description: 授权版本（本专题唯一定义，F06）：从 1 开始，每次授权/策略变化单调 +1；不存在 0。agent-runtime 应 $ref 本定义。

RecordRevision.description: Memory record 的修订号：创建时为 1，每次 revise 成功 +1；不存在 0。

Receipt.description: source_refs expose the exact persisted provenance returned by the same commit as observation_ids and record_refs. P0 explicit remember/revise returns committed with non-null read/index watermarks; duplicate returns the same original receipt after current authorization/erase checks, never re-executes the source or restores old content.

OwnerRecordRevision.description: Memory record 的修订号：创建时为 1，每次 revise 成功 +1；不存在 0。

Source.description: Durable resolved provenance. Discriminator kind is mandatory; Message and State assertions have independent owners and revision domains.

history_generation.$comment: Message history generation: zero-based (message migration 010) and carried as a decimal string on the wire (json:",string").

source_revision.$comment: Opaque Message-owned revision of the source item. P0 candidate (pending Message owner confirmation): the finished-receipt ReplyUpdatedAt in microseconds, the same derivation as cloud_product_state_outbox payload.revision. FinishConversationRun does not itself validate a source revision.

MessageSource.description: Message-owned durable provenance. Source ID, generation and revision are resolved from the authorized Message owner, never generated by State or supplied as trusted data by a Harness.

AssertionSource.description: Immutable State assertion provenance, scoped and owned by one canonical record lineage. No Message identity, generation or revision is synthesized.

AssertionRevision.description: State-owned explicit assertion revision: starts at 1; correction under the owning record CAS advances it. This is not Message source_revision/history_generation.

ErasureEpoch.description: 擦除代数（本专题唯一定义，F06）：0 表示该 scope 从未执行 forget/erasure，每次 forget 提交后单调 +1；旧代数的数据和 checkpoint 不得恢复。agent-runtime 应 $ref 本定义。

ShouldRetry.description: 重试是否可能成功（对齐 E2B Should-Retry，B1e⑩）。true：暂时性失败（容量不足、限流、恢复进行中），有 Retry-After 时按它等待，否则指数退避；false：重试不能解决（请求错误、配置问题），或结果未知（重试可能造成第二次副作用）。成功响应与未分类的错误省略此头。

x-owner-status: producer/consumer changes proposed; owner directories not modified
